items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: the piano player was named Bill Austin. He used to play with Louis Jordan.

ctx.x: He'd been trying to get something, and I'd call him, you know, "Anything happen yet?" "No, just have something you can put your hand on. No use rehearsing. Have something you can put your hand on in case I come up with something." I said all right. I had the guys on the block there, Hal Austin the drummer, and the bass player, John Brown, and the piano player was named Bill Austin. He used to play with Louis Jordan. So now he says, "I'm waiting on a little something over in Jersey, you know." I said good. "I…
these three guys I was telling you about, and I told them how to play the room, because I knew how to play it because I played there with Joe Bushkin.
